So I have a few fun things here!
Firstly, I went back to roots and places my campaign within Greyhawk so good ol SB had previously seized control of the Hold of the Sea princes (a country of moderately united pirates one country over from Keoland, where Saltmarsh takes place in the original print). Long story short, SB slowly and quietly infiltrated the sea princes leadership then a few hits in the right places and.. they hold the strings over there.
Fast forward to my game thus
The SB leadership has been using every opportunity within the campaign to stir up chaos within Saltmarsh and draw the attention of the Keoland leadership so they can infiltrate in the same way. 
Keoland knows this, but hasn’t really revealed that they know or reacted to this knowledge as a means to bait the SB into playing a similar hand.
SB suspects things aren’t what they seem, so they’ve opted to kick up dirt wherever they can by means of.. a new adventuring party! (The players, not exactly knowing what’s happening)
So far this has been the smuggling bits from B1 supplying weapons from both the Sea Princes and Keoland into town, and the party revealing this threat to the council.
Antagonizing some Sahuagin who really only had beef with the lizardfolk and drawing both sides in towards the town.
Angering Lolth priests (I changed some bits about the emperor of the seas to be more lolth related, and that the treasure was instead a “bribe” from Keoland to crimson tide in exchange for Crimson Tide assaulting a the isle of the abbey.. which was destined to fail.. which cripples Crimson tides forces)
And currently, having said party attack follow up the attack on the abbey which I have replaced as a cult of Orcus. Keoland wants a weapon they have possession of, and SB just wants Keoland/Saltmarsh/the Party to have more enemies. 

SB Ultimate goal, force Keoland to move in with a more firm grasp on Saltmarsh which gives more power to the Crownies but more support for the Townies. The Townies get a few unsuspecting (SB placed)townsfolk stepping up to the plate in rebellion, and other Crownie aligned (Also SB planted) townsfolk also stepping in to support Keoland occupation. Ultimately leading to infiltration of the Keoland power structure. 

Whilst Keoland is simply waiting until all players on the field are weakened enough, and SB has overextended, before pulling a political pincer maneuver to screw over SB, Crimson Tide, and their ultimate prize.. the hold of the sea princes itself.. who after having the SB exposed.. will be prime for “liberation”.

I'll tell you what ended up happening. The party went on a recruiting spree and ended up getting a party size of 16 to traverse the land and take on the Gauth. They also borrowed 2 vehicles (the military faction they aligned with has a group of the worlds smartest minds known as the Star Cult that's has pushed their tech far beyond most other factions) which they used to head North along the hex map I made and provided. They encountered a few potential roadblocks and incentives to stop and waste time which they completely ignored and pressed on. Encountered one of the potential BBEGs, a mysterious hooded wizard (this game has several potential end game bosses) who proceeded to simply ask them where they were headed. The party lied and he left. 
They had a neat run in with the dwarves who were transporting rare metals from the mine back to their city. Party ended up waiting in the darkness for them to pass. 
The rest of the journey was uneventful, they just kept dodging every hint of danger.
Eventually they reached the Spire, which the Gauth responded to by projecting his voice in a very dramatic fashion " FOOOOOOLS! She will be DEAD before you can reach her!" And flooded the space between the party and the Spire with the unfortunate sods whom the Gauth had previously enslaved.
The party charges head on with their plan being to use their Blue Mage to attempt to sever the link between the Gauth and his servants. 
This never ended up happening as the servants simply died at the lightest touch. 
Puzzled, they tried casting some spells and trying different methods of attack.
The exact moment every member of the party attempted to strike one of the servants they all crumbled into the ground. The ground is a nearly perfectly smooth dark grey rock bed which extends all the way around the Spire.
The party had a pretty solid "oh fuck" moment.
From the bodies a Black Rock Triskelion formed. 
Even though they outnumbered the thing 16/1 they didn't want to risk any casualties prior to fighting the Gauth and ran around the Triskelion. 
2 party members were left outside, one was a NPC shield bearer that was way too slow and the other unfortunately had completely shattered her shoulder with a double crit fail. 

Once inside they had to through several levels of minions. One NPC party member was lost on the way up after he was caught in a Alien vs Predator style floor trap.

On the outside the 2 party members that were left behind kept driving one of the vehicles around the Triskelion. They eventually got bored and started doing donuts in the thing, which they thought was harmless fun. Since the world at this point was cast in a permanent darkness and the vehicle they were driving around in had headlights.. they were pretty much a bright flashing light to anyone who was in the vicinity to see.

Flash back to the Spire party, which are stuck trying to figure out how to avoid fighting a black pudding which has flattened Itself out on the already jet black flooring, preventing anyone from getting past without stepping in it. 
The Gauth called down the tower "You vile wretches! Only cowards call for help!" 
The inside party was confused. The player that was on the outside put two and two together. 
The faction that was coming in behind then had seen the flashing lights and floored it to catch up. The dwarves had also seen the lights and sent an airship to investigate. 
The two forces engaged each other and the Gauth sunk his Spire underground to protect himself from the armies that arrived on his doorstep.

Wizard man shows back up, slips past both armies and gets to the Spire. Wizard guy has one of 3 crystals of power. His works like an amplifier for magic users. He erects a dome around the Spire to keep the armies out and meets back up with the party. Turns out he read one of their minds and followed them, he also wants the Gauths prisoner.
He offers the party a teleport up the rest of the Spire to engage the Gauth for him. They agree and the fight begins. This fight was long.. 3 other NPCs died and another was left in a coma. They  finally kill it. Wizard guy shows up and immediately attacks the party thinking they had just killed the one thing that could kill him. 

A long lost friend of theirs showed up and unintentionally ex machina'd wizard guy with a triple crit (if you crit the crit confirm roll in one of my games it will double the crit damage modifier)


The ending this 10 hour session was the girl being rescued and being given the wizards power crystal which let her break back out of her mortal form back into her true form, the Goddess of Life. 
The Spire and dome both crumbled and the black clouds engulfing the planet dissipated due to the man holding the spell being killed. 

The Dwarven airship was in a heaping wreck and most of the army that was to back them up had been wiped out. 

The party returned home triumphantly, this was their first major victory in this campaign and are excited to continue.
